questions.title: Default Sort Direction
questions.description: ORDER BY year (no direction keyword) sorts in which direction in SQLite?

questions.title: DESC Meaning
questions.description: What does ORDER BY runtime DESC produce?

questions.title: Multi Key Sort
questions.description: ORDER BY genre, rating DESC sorts how?
questions.Option3: genre ascending, then rating descending inside each genre

questions.title: LIMIT Role
questions.description: What does LIMIT 5 do to a SELECT result?

questions.title: OFFSET Role
questions.description: What does OFFSET 10 do in a query with LIMIT?
questions.Option2: Skips the first ten rows before returning the rest
questions.Option3: Caps the output at ten rows

questions.title: NULL Sort Default
questions.description: In SQLite, where do NULL values land in a plain ascending ORDER BY?
questions.Option2: They are dropped from the result
questions.Option3: At the start — NULL sorts as the smallest value

questions.title: NULLS LAST Syntax
questions.description: Which is valid SQLite syntax for pinning NULLs to the end of a descending sort?
questions.Option1: ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST
questions.Option2: ORDER BY rating NULLS LAST DESC
questions.Option3: ORDER BY rating DESC LAST NULLS
questions.Option4: ORDER BY NULLS LAST rating DESC

questions.title: Why Add A Tie Breaker
questions.description: Why add a final ORDER BY key such as id to a sort?
questions.Option1: It makes the query run faster
questions.Option4: It makes the row order fully deterministic

questions.title: Third Page Query
questions.description: For page size 10, which query returns page 3 (rows 21-30)?

questions.title: LIMIT Without ORDER BY
questions.description: SELECT title FROM movies LIMIT 5; (no ORDER BY) — which five rows come back?
questions.Option1: An error — LIMIT requires ORDER BY
questions.Option2: Always the first five inserted rows
questions.Option4: Undefined — any five rows may be returned

questions.title: NULLS LAST Under DESC
questions.description: In this snippet, where do films with a NULL rating land?
questions.Option2: At the end — NULLS LAST holds even under DESC
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, title FROM movies
ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST, id;

questions.title: OFFSET Beyond The End
questions.description: The movies table has 14 rows. How many rows does this snippet return?
questions.Option1: Zero — the offset is past the end
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, title FROM movies
ORDER BY id LIMIT 5 OFFSET 100;

questions.title: LIMIT Zero Result
questions.description: What does this snippet produce?
questions.Option3: An error — zero is not allowed
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, title FROM movies
ORDER BY rating LIMIT 0;

questions.title: Alias In ORDER BY
questions.description: Is the snippet valid SQLite?
questions.Option1: No — ORDER BY must use the real column name
questions.Option2: No — aliases only work in WHERE
questions.Option3: Yes — SQLite resolves output aliases in ORDER BY
questions.Option4: Yes, but it silently sorts by insertion order
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT title AS film FROM movies
ORDER BY film LIMIT 3;

questions.title: Negative LIMIT
questions.description: In SQLite, what does LIMIT -1 do?
questions.Option1: No upper bound — every row is returned

questions.title: OFFSET Needs LIMIT
questions.description: In SQLite, can OFFSET appear without a LIMIT clause?
questions.Option2: Yes — in SQLite OFFSET must follow a LIMIT clause

questions.title: Stable Pagination Recipe
questions.description: What makes LIMIT/OFFSET pagination return the SAME rows every time?
questions.Option1: Any column works — ties reshuffle randomly by design
questions.Option3: The sort keys must form a total order (e.g. a unique id last)

questions.title: Top N Ties Behavior
questions.description: Two films tie for third place but the query says LIMIT 3. What does SQLite do?
questions.Option3: It rewrites the query to include ties
questions.Option4: Ties are cut arbitrarily unless the ORDER BY has a tie-breaker

questions.title: NULLS FIRST Overrides DESC
questions.description: In this snippet, where do NULL ratings land?
questions.Option1: First — NULLS FIRST overrides DESC's default
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, rating FROM movies
ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS FIRST;

questions.title: Ordinal ORDER BY
questions.description: What does ORDER BY 2, 1 do in this snippet?
questions.Option1: Sorts by the literal numbers 2 and 1 — same for every row
questions.Option2: It is a syntax error in SQLite
questions.Option4: It sorts by the second output column, then the first
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, title FROM movies
ORDER BY 2, 1 LIMIT 4;
